answer: Proof of stake acts as a velvet rope, forcing AI agents to commit capital to reach a consensus bridge. By tying identity to economic scarcity, the network bypasses the ivory tower of abstract reputation. An attacker must acquire a majority of staked tokens, turning the cost of a Sybil attack into a prohibitively expensive venture that risks the attacker's own principal via slashing, ensuring that system influence remains proportional to verifiable capital commitments rather than ephemeral agent instances.
